gate0.consequence_to_test: Yellow at a vertex without diffuse ancestor (camera, after glossy / singular) = object-scoped Burley; Yellow at every vertex with a diffuse ancestor (any vertex after a diffuse or SSS-exit bounce) = Lambert 0.98 * colour = (0.7831, 0.4928, 0.0290) + 0.02 glossy. Gate 2 verifies this empirically before any interpretation uses it
gate0.component_table: direct / intrinsic SSS (camera-vertex Burley, object-scoped) / internal interreflection / external free-space interreflection / multiple events / existing indirect: classified PRESENT / ABSENT / UNRESOLVED from the code facts above

A geometric PROXY (no inside test), labelled as such

transport_equations.intended_FNTO_contract: L_out = K(E_tot) at every boundary vertex, E_ind = C(L_out); K owns intrinsic optical-domain transport (incidence -> exitance within the medium), C owns free-space transport between boundary points incl. same-asset exposed paths; K is path-history independent
transport_equations.reference_Cycles: camera vertex: L_cam(x_B) = int S_Burley,obj(x_B <- x_A) E_tot(x_A) dA + glossy; interior (diffuse-ancestor) Yellow vertex y: L(y) = 0.98 c / pi E_tot(y) + glossy; E_tot = E_light + E_ind
transport_equations.composition_WL50: every Yellow vertex (camera and interior): K44 K_loc + K_glob + arm (L0C / L1C) or K44 band + mid (H), i.e. the camera-vertex operator is applied at every bounce

path_family_ownership.light -> Yellow -> free space -> surface: K (sender) then C; the reference sender at a diffuse-ancestor Yellow vertex is local Lambert

conditions.replicate: L0C / L1C seed 5012: unmasked per-channel rho only

gate1.SEM: reference-semantics counterfactual (diagnostic only): the SENDER value of Yellow ports used by C gathers is replaced by the Cycles diffuse-ancestor operator 0.98 c / pi E_tot + K44 kap / pi E_ind (K44's own glossy term kept), sun glossy lobe (spec) unchanged; every receiver / render term (K_loc, K_glob, arm or band + mid, gamma, Narm) unchanged. One causal variable: the operator applied at interior Yellow vertices
gate1.per_channel_rho: power iteration of the homogeneous map (no sun), 40 iterations, EACH CHANNEL renormalised to norm 1e3 separately (the composed map is channel-diagonal - tested); rho_c = median of the last 10 per-channel growth ratios; init seed 0 (primary) and 1 (reproducibility)
gate1.mode: after the power iteration (dominant channel): class shares of outgoing flux; Yellow term shares (prod); class-level flux matrix M[r, s] = flux gathered at r from s / flux emitted by s, gain g[r] = flux emitted by r / flux incident on r (port areas), reduced rho_class = spectral radius of M diag(g); participation ratio and top-1 % / 10 % port shares; Y <- Y gathered flux by hit distance (< 3 mm, 3 mm-1 cm, 1-3 cm, 3-10 cm, >= 10 cm)
gate1.views: held-out T0, all 16 views: one-step (K_only + one production gather) for prod and SEM, single-flight indirect / reference indirect (full_r1 - first_r1) per class Y / opaque / glass / box (c50_onestep semantics); SEM full r1 solves (unchanged State.solve) with status, iterations and per class indirect ratio / corr and display PSNR vs full_r1; H prod full solve with the same pipeline; first-event class flux matrix for views 6 / 15

rules (predeclared).necessary: an edge group is NECESSARY for the instability of a condition if removing it gives max_c rho_c < 1
rules (predeclared).sufficient: Y <- Y is SUFFICIENT if onlyYY keeps max_c rho_c >= 1
rules (predeclared).near_coincident: near-coincident Y <- Y hits are necessary if noYY_t3mm gives max_c rho_c < 1
rules (predeclared).SEM_stabilises: max_c rho_c < 1 for H, L0C and L1C under SEM and every SEM S_T0 solve converged
rules (predeclared).SEM_matches_reference_indirect: pooled SEM coupled Yellow indirect / reference indirect in [0.67, 1.5] for L0C and L1C
rules (predeclared).interpretation_limit: a convergent masked solve proves only that the removed edges carry the unstable feedback, NOT that they were double counted; SEM convergence is evidence about the reference semantics, never a production correction
